label: Specification for: AMENDMENT_MONTH_STANDARDIZED
description: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:month is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:month if it can be unambiguously interpreted as a month represented as an integer between 1 and 12 inclusive; otherwise NOT_AMENDED
expectedResponse: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:month is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:month if it can be unambiguously interpreted as a month represented as an integer between 1 and 12 inclusive; otherwise NOT_AMENDED
example1: dwc:month="IV": Response.status=AMENDED, Response.result=dwc:month="4", Response.comment="dwc:month interpreted as roman numerals "
example2: dwc:month="Ma": Response.status=NOT_AMENDED, Response.result=, Response.comment="dwc:month contains an ambiguous value"
